entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. How may I assist you today?
I need to return a VeloBand Pulse I bought a little over two weeks ago. It's not working like I expected. This is ridiculous, I need this sorted fast.

I understand your frustration. I'm sorry to hear you're having issues with your VeloBand Pulse. Let me pull up your order information. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with the purchase?
It's order number VF789456. Hurry it up, please.

Okay, I have order VF789456. I see you purchased the VeloBand Pulse 15 days ago. I apologize again that you're not satisfied. Our standard return policy is 90 days for a full refund. No problem at all to get the return processed for you.
Ninety days? Seriously? Well, why didn’t anyone tell me this before? I’ve been stressing about this for days thinking I was stuck with this useless smart watch. Just get the return started.

Absolutely. To initiate the return, I'll send you a prepaid shipping label via email. Simply pack up your VeloBand Pulse, affix the label, and drop it off at your nearest carrier location. Once we receive the returned item, we'll process your refund. You should see the credit reflected in your account within 7-10 business days.
Alright, that sounds good. So I can expect the label in my email shortly?

Yes, the email with the prepaid shipping label has already been sent to the email address associated with your account. Please allow a few minutes for it to arrive. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, I think that's everything. Thank you so much for your help! I feel much better now.
You're very welcome! We appreciate your business with VeloFit. Have a great day!
